defensives.name: Ice Block
defensives.usage_rule: Full immunity for one lethal hit or a debuff you cannot survive, at the cost of every cast during the 10 seconds.

defensives.name: Ice Cold
defensives.usage_rule: Take 70% less damage for 6 seconds while still casting, so use it on a big hit you want to keep uptime through.

defensives.name: Blazing Barrier
defensives.usage_rule: Keep it refreshed ahead of every damage event; it is your only defensive cheap enough to hold near 100% uptime.

defensives.name: Alter Time
defensives.usage_rule: Press it before a predictable hit and press it again within 10 seconds to snap back to that health and position.

defensives.name: Greater Invisibility
defensives.usage_rule: Drop threat and go untargetable to shed a fixated mob or a stacking debuff; any action you take cancels it.
